source: NJ statewide LiDAR, NortheastNJPostSandy_2014_QL2, flown 2014-10-21, ~3.4 pts/m2 (s3://njogis-elevation)
method: height = 98th percentile of returns within 40% of the estimated crown radius, above a 2 m ground raster; crown base = lowest 1 m bin where two consecutive bins hold 15% of the peak count. Rooftops masked with OSM footprints.
caveat: flown leaf-off in late October and 12 years old; positions come from the inventory's GPS, so a misplaced tree samples the wrong crown
